name: Bad Grip Club Demo
summary:
This demo includes one of the four biomes from the full game — a first taste of the climb.

Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game for VR with crossplay. Climb a cartoonish mountain where physical grip and teamwork are your only hope.

VR IMMERSIVE CLIMBING

Feel the height and the risk of falling as you climb using your actual hands. Grab ledges, hold your grip, and recover from slips. If you do lose your hold, expect an immersive — and comical — crash landing!
